title: What Paxos Consensus Internals Is All About
description: The original consensus: proposers, acceptors, and the two phases that started it all.. This database covers Paxos Consensus Internals with full records: definitions, key facts, working procedures, and runnable demo programs, arranged on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. Consensus is agreement despite failures; it's the core of distributed systems.
